wan = "vio0"
set block-policy drop
set state-policy floating
set optimization normal
set limit states 100000
set syncookies never
set skip on { lo }
set loginterface none
block drop all label "opf:builtin:default-block"
pass out inet all flags S/SA label "opf:builtin:self-out"
pass out inet6 all flags S/SA label "opf:builtin:self-out"
block return all label "opf:rule:imp1"
pass all flags S/SA label "opf:rule:imp2"
block return in on ! lo0 proto tcp from any to any port 6000:6010
